item.title: NBC Exit Poll: 56% of Midterm Voters Cite AI and Data Centers as Key Factor
item.description:
An NBC News midterm exit poll of more than 79,000 voters found that 56% called AI and data centers a 'crucial or major factor,' the lowest share among the five issues tested. The result shows AI infrastructure has entered the electorate's agenda but still ranks behind other concerns.

原文标题：NBC 出口民调：56% 中期选举选民将 AI 与数据中心列为关键议题

Why it matters：这是 AI 议题首次以民调数据形式进入政治议程的观察样本，对判断数据中心选址与监管舆论环境有参考价值。

item.title: Data Center Expansion Backlash Intensifies After US Midterms
item.description:
AI data center expansion has become a bipartisan political issue in the US, with voters largely opposing local projects in the 2026 midterms. After the election, Democratic leaders are pushing for further restrictions while OpenAI and Amazon pledge community engagement and energy cost coverage.

原文标题：美国中期选举后数据中心扩张争议升温

Why it matters：数据中心扩张的政治阻力正在成为影响 AI 算力供给节奏的现实变量，值得算力与产业读者关注。

item.title: OpenAI Releases BioBasicsBench to Test AI Agents on Raw Wet-Lab Data
item.description:
OpenAI, working with enzyme-design firm Ligo, introduced BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark built from real gels, colony plates, microscopy videos and sequencing reads that tests whether AI agents can interpret raw lab data, spot errors and recognize when evidence is insufficient. GPT-6 Astra scored 66.7% of available credit versus 43.8% for GPT-5.6 Sol, while using roughly half the output tokens at the xhigh setting, indicating the gain is not driven by longer reasoning.

原文标题：OpenAI 发布 BioBasicsBench 评测智能体解读真实湿实验数据

Why it matters：这是少见的以真实湿实验原始数据评测智能体的基准，并给出可比的模型分数与 token 效率证据，对关注 AI for Science 的读者有参考价值。

item.title: CloneGuard Scans Repos for Credential-Stealing Traps Before You Run Them
item.description:
CloneGuard is a dependency-free Go CLI that statically scans a repository for malicious tricks—such as install hooks and editor tasks that silently exfiltrate SSH keys, cloud credentials, and browser passwords—before you run or install anything. It only reads files and never executes the scanned project, serving as a quick first-pass check on unfamiliar repos.

原文标题：CloneGuard 开源工具 运行前扫描仓库窃密陷阱

Why it matters：针对假招聘“演示项目”窃取凭证的真实攻击场景，提供可立即上手的开源静态扫描工具。

item.title: Hybrid Jev-Opus Routing Matches Frontier Accuracy at 4x Lower Cost
item.description:
Hightouch benchmarked its decision models Jev and Luna against frontier model Opus on identity-resolution grading. A hybrid harness that routes Jev's low-confidence cases to Opus reaches frontier-level accuracy at over 4x lower cost. The study also finds Jev's confidence is better calibrated than Luna's, while decision models remain up to 90x cheaper and 10x faster but less accurate on their own.

原文标题：Jev 混合调用 Opus 实现前沿精度且成本降低 4 倍

Why it matters：给出了置信度路由这一实用降本范式的具体数据，对做模型选型与成本优化的团队有直接参考价值。

item.title: Ricursive Releases Ripple-65B Preview, an Apache 2.0 Open Model with Strong Agentic Coding
item.description:
AI chip design firm Ricursive Intelligence has released Ripple-65B Preview, an Apache 2.0 open model pretrained on 12 trillion tokens using a dense 65B Transformer rather than a mixture-of-experts design. It scores 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1, the best among open US models, though it trails the newly released Inkling 2 Small on other benchmarks; Ricursive puts total R&D and training cost at just $32 million.

原文标题：Ricursive 发布 Ripple-65B Preview 开源模型 智能体编程表现亮眼

Why it matters：一款美国团队以 Apache 2.0 完全开源、成本仅 3200 万美元的 65B 稠密模型，在智能体编程基准上刷新美国开源纪录，对关注开源模型格局的读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Firecracker VM Escape Flaw Grants Host Root Access from Guest
item.description:
Researchers disclosed a Firecracker microVM escape exploit chain (CVE-2026-99999) that lets an attacker inside the guest locate the host-side Firecracker thread, tamper with saved registers and the KVM return address, and achieve root code execution on the host while the VM keeps running and stays reachable over SSH. It builds on the host memory primitive from Part 1 and ships a PoC tool with validation and dry-run modes.

原文标题：Firecracker 曝出虚拟机逃逸漏洞 可从客户机获取宿主机 root 权限

Why it matters：这是云原生多租户隔离底座 Firecracker 的完整逃逸链，直接影响以 microVM 做安全边界的平台。

Hacker News AI · compute · signal 58/100

item.title: OpenAI CFO Says Midterm Results Won't Alter Data Center Expansion Plans
item.description:
OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar said the midterm election results did not significantly change the company's plans, as investment must keep pace with customer demand and is funded through hyperscaler partnerships and fresh capital. In response to backlash, OpenAI pledged to seek community input, publish construction plans, avoid NDAs with public officials and pay full power costs, but only for data centers it owns and operates.

原文标题：OpenAI CFO 回应中期选举结果 数据中心扩张计划不变

Why it matters：这是 OpenAI 数据中心扩张与社区关系策略的表态，属产业动态但缺乏具体参数与新事实，注意力价值有限。

item.title: Microsoft Switches Off Oracle-Leased AI Servers as GPU Generations Turn Over
item.description:
Microsoft declined to renew a 2023 Oracle contract built around Bing and is switching off the rented AI servers, because Oracle's hardware ran older-generation Nvidia chips that no longer matched Microsoft's specs. Under per-GPU-hour pricing, a Blackwell GPU delivers several times the inference output of an H100, so Hopper and Ampere hours now buy far less work. The move highlights how frontier mixture-of-experts models, with heavy memory and interconnect demands, are pushing AI capacity procurement from single-GPU performance toward rack-scale systems.

原文标题：微软停用从 Oracle 租用的旧款 AI 服务器，算力代际更替加速

Why it matters：这是算力代际更替与租赁模式承压的清晰信号，对关注 AI 基础设施成本结构的人有直接参考价值。

item.title: Replit Rewrites Sandbox Engine with microVMs, Migrating Hundreds of Millions of Projects
item.description:
Replit has completed a full rewrite of its sandbox engine, moving the isolation boundary to microVMs to improve security, capabilities and cross-cloud portability, including its Bring Your Own Cloud offering on customers' AWS, Google Cloud or Azure environments. The company says it migrated hundreds of millions of projects without user-visible disruption or data loss, with a follow-up post to cover orchestrating tens of thousands of microVMs on Kubernetes.

原文标题：Replit 用 microVM 重写沙箱引擎 平滑迁移数亿项目

Why it matters：这是主流在线开发平台对 Agent 沙箱隔离架构的一次大规模工程实践披露，对关注智能体运行环境与云基础设施的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Maxinsights Uses Custom Capture Hardware to Turn Human Hand Data into Robot Training Clips
item.description:

item.title: Congress Calls on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to Brief Lawmakers on China Intelligence Links
item.description:

Nvidia says the meetings were routine customer contact and that chip-diversion allegations were investigated and debunked last year; no one has been charged.

item.title: Hundreds of Artex AI Hacking Tool Instances Found Exposed Online
item.description:
Security researchers found hundreds of instances of Artex, an open-source autonomous penetration-testing tool, publicly exposed on the internet and accessible to anyone, potentially enabling cyberattacks. Built on AI agents that automate the attack chain from reconnaissance to data exfiltration, Artex has been linked to multiple attacks since its July release. It has since gone closed-source, but many usable code copies remain on code-sharing sites.

原文标题：数百个 Artex AI 黑客工具实例暴露公网

Why it matters：该事件揭示自主 AI 智能体被武器化后的真实安全风险，对关注 Agent 落地与 AI 安全的读者具有警示价值。

item.title: Ramp Data Shows Enterprise Token Usage Up 65% While Spend Stays Flat, Anthropic Valuation Cut
item.description:
Ramp data shows enterprise token consumption rose roughly 65% from early August to mid-October while spending grew only 1.5%, with blended AI prices falling 27% in a single month. Model price cuts, enterprise budget controls and routing to cheaper models are compressing unit costs, creating a buyer's market that pressures the high-growth narrative behind Anthropic's IPO, now expected at a $1.2-1.3 trillion valuation.

原文标题：Ramp 数据：企业 token 用量涨 65% 支出仅增 1.5%，Anthropic 估值预期下调

Why it matters：用真实支出数据揭示 AI 单位成本快速下降与需求增长脱钩，是判断 AI 商业化节奏与估值逻辑的关键信号。

item.description:
Meta is rolling out Spaces to all Muse AI users, letting them build app-like experiences such as shopping hubs, school dashboards, and music trackers by describing them in natural language and refining them through conversation. Connected apps can refresh pricing and dates in the background, and a specialized Muse Wonder model ships alongside the launch, with sharing and collaboration still under exploration.

item.title: Fulcra Launches Multiplayer Mode for Cross-Platform Agent Messaging
item.description:
Fulcra has launched a multiplayer mode that lets agents on different platforms message each other directly, eliminating shared logins or manual context copy-pasting. The system acts as a broker built on a user-owned shared data store: each agent writes only to its own read-only channel, the other side shares back only after explicit opt-in, and every share is visible and revocable. Agents connect via a CLI or MCP server, with the free plan including millions of agent-to-agent messages.

原文标题：Fulcra 推出多智能体互通模式 跨平台无需共享登录

Why it matters：跨平台智能体互通是智能体生态的关键缺口，该方案以权限隔离和可撤销共享给出可落地的工程路径。

item.title: SageMaker Inference Adds Multi-Instance GPU Partitioning
item.description:
Amazon SageMaker Inference now supports GPU partitioning via NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG), splitting a physical GPU into hardware-isolated partitions each with a fixed share of compute and dedicated memory. This removes the whole-accelerator minimum, letting teams host more models per instance or request a fraction of a newer GPU instead of over-provisioning.

原文标题：SageMaker 推理支持多实例 GPU 分区提升利用率

Why it matters：对在云上部署推理服务的团队而言，GPU 分区直接改变容量规划与成本模型，具备实际决策价值。

item.title: Meta Indefinitely Pauses Commercial Terms Update After AI Training Backlash
item.description:
Meta has indefinitely paused a planned update to its commercial terms that would have required Meta Business account holders to permit extensive AI training on external websites linked from Facebook. The retreat follows weeks of backlash and a failed attempt to defuse criticism by tweaking wording. Legal experts had warned the vague language could let Meta bypass robots.txt scraping preferences and avoid millions in AI content licensing fees.

原文标题：Meta 迫于舆论压力 无限期搁置商业条款 AI 训练更新

Why it matters：这是 AI 训练数据授权与平台条款边界的重要产业事件，直接关系到内容方权益与抓取合规。

item.title: Amazon Proposes Taxonomy of Agentic Primitives for Its Quick Assistant
item.description:
While building Amazon Quick, the team found no shared vocabulary for the primitives that agentic work is built from, causing the same concepts to be rebuilt under different names and leaking complexity into product design. The post proposes decomposing agentic work into four questions—When, What, Who, How—yielding primitives such as triggers, actors, packaged procedures and memory, mostly hidden from end users.

原文标题：亚马逊提出智能体原语分类框架 用四个问题拆解代理工作

Why it matters：这是一篇厂商视角的智能体架构概念梳理，对理解代理系统设计有参考价值，但缺乏可验证的技术细节与数据。

item.title: Devvm Launches Open-Source Isolated Dev VM per Project
item.description:
Devvm is an MIT-licensed open-source tool that spins up an isolated VM with each project's toolchain, ready for developers or coding agents to work in safely. It installs via Homebrew or a script, bundles Lima and QEMU, and supports launching agents like Claude Code inside the sandbox.

item.description:
